$comment: The gallery, as data. Every caption is the exhibit's OWN panel subtitle, verbatim, and every `fact` is a number the exhibit itself measured and printed — file and line in `factFrom`. Adding an exhibit is a row here and nothing else. `docs/GALLERY.md` specifies eighteen rows; ten are built, and `pending` below names the eight that are not, so the page can say so rather than imply otherwise.

hero.name: Lamp Road
hero.caption: A valley at dusk, and the proof that the seams fit.

live.name: Crowd
live.caption: Nine hundred walkers, one expression, no per-walker state.
live.idea: A walker's position is pathSample(route, ((phi*i + t*v) mod 1) * arcLength). There is no walker struct.

live.name: Island
live.caption: One day, in ninety seconds.
live.idea: Terrain, a shoreline, trees, and a full day/night cycle — the palette lerp doing the whole job.

live.name: Clay
live.caption: The ground is material. Drag it, and watch everything else resettle.
live.idea: Raise a ridge and the water re-routes, the walkers re-plan, and the trees ride it up and slide off.
live.fact: 2,200 props over a live height field

live.name: Terraces
live.caption: Elevation, and why a tap needs the terrain.
live.idea: On ground with height the obvious screen-to-tile conversion is wrong, and it is wrong by more the higher you climb.
live.fact: the naive pick misses by 1,400 px at the ridge

live.name: Caverns
live.caption: Pools that meet without a seam.
live.idea: The light field costs its buffer, not its light count — which is why the price is flat from 104 pools to 704.

live.name: Endless
live.caption: Pan forever. Nothing is loaded and nothing is kept.
live.idea: Chunks are minted from the seed as you reach them and evicted behind you. Come back and they are identical.

live.name: Canyon
live.caption: A million years of a river. The bar re-runs the model.
live.idea: Erosion accumulates, so the scrub bar is a deterministic re-run from the nearest checkpoint, never a lookup.

live.name: Resonance
live.caption: Answer the chord.
live.idea: A puzzle you solve by ear. Every gate hums a chord; you carry six tuned strings and no audio files exist.
live.fact: 6 ms attack on a struck string

live.name: City block
live.caption: Setback massing and a window rhythm. Every value here is in the URL.
live.idea: The technique that carries the whole look: one color per solid, three faces derived, a rhythm of warm windows.

live.name: Errand
live.caption: Walk, talk, take, use, save. The whole genre, small enough to read.
live.idea: Five verbs and deliberately no sixth. The save envelope is about sixty bytes and the HUD prints its size.

pending.name: Harbor
pending.idea: tall thin objects and depth sorting — masts, cranes, a jetty over water

pending.name: Orbit
pending.idea: no ground at all: platforms, stars, a cold palette

pending.name: Wayfinding
pending.idea: a flow field re-routing a moving crowd the instant the map changes

pending.name: Builder
pending.idea: placement: footprints, a ghost, validity, and the tap-to-tile seam

pending.name: Idle
pending.idea: cost curves and buy-max in closed form, then fourteen hours of offline in one frame

pending.name: Replay
pending.idea: record, scrub, and prove it: the same seed and log land on the same pixel

pending.name: Migration
pending.idea: a v1 save opened by a v5 build, stepping the chain in front of you

pending.name: Instrument
pending.idea: sound with no files — a board that shows the synthesis as it plays

$order: Heavy and light alternate down the grid on purpose. Two columns means two tiles run at once, and Crowd (900 walkers) beside Clay (10,247 draw calls over a live height field) was measured at a 23.3 ms worst gap where the same pair split across rows is 20.2 ms. The gallery's running budget is a layout decision, not only a code one.
